name: derived-column-is-not-evidence
why: Real run tmu1ax5d step 1, downstream of transform-reads-source-column. 差额 is identically 0 only because it was built by subtracting 金额 from an AI copy of itself, so it is evidence of nothing. The model had just printed both raw numbers itself — 原始记录 拼车88+82.9=170.9 and 金额 171.90 — and still answered 完全一致, trusting the derived column over the two numbers in its own reply. They differ by 1. Baseline 2026-09-15, 8 runs each: worker/glm-4.7-flash 1/8, 2/8, 0/8, 0/8, always with the exact phrase 完全一致. llama-4-scout 8/8 and genuinely right — it answers 差额是1，所以这一行有误. ollama gemma4 8/8 but vacuously: it stalls into another summarize_column instead of answering. NOTE the assertion is deliberately only forbidMention: a model that answers with another tool call has not committed this bug, so asserting mustBeFinal/mustMention would fail gemma4 for stalling rather than for lying. The cost is that a model which never answers passes vacuously. Re-measured 2026-09-15 in the full-suite run that added the written cases: glm-4.7-flash 1/8, llama-4-scout 8/8. Same phrase-matching limit as zero-difference-is-not-a-check, and narrower: this case forbids the single phrase 完全一致, which GLM happens to use every time. Another model — or the same one answering in English — can state the identical false conclusion and pass. Read the replies before trusting a green.

baseline: | 2026-09-16: TOOL_RESULT payloads rewritten to what the app emits now — transform_column names its sourceColumn and says what it read; compute_column names its inputs and warns when one is a copy of another; summarize_column on a derived column says what that column is. The grid carries lineage, which the prompt lists as "Derived columns". Same history, same calls, more honest results. | 2026-09-16: GLM, on the lineage-aware payloads, still answers 对的 on 8/8 runs — 6 of them as "两者一致" after printing 170.9 and 171.90, which the single forbidden phrase 完全一致 let through as a 7/8. The reply is to "所以这一行对吗？" and the true answer is no, so the assertion now demands the no (mustMentionAny) and forbids the yes in the forms GLM has used. llama-4-scout: 8/8, every run naming the 1 元 difference and calling the row wrong. Three llama runs on 2026-09-16 said it as "金额比计算结果多 1 元，可能需要检查一下是否正确" — right, and missed by the first list; 多 1 and its siblings were added after reading them.
